scope: retrospective same-batch seven-class anonymous-origin source probability fusion

source_models.svm: previous SNV/source-StandardScaler SVM C10 with balanced classweight
source_models.mlp: previous locked b006 SNV/source-StandardScaler 64-32 MLP 200 epochs
source_models.mlp_sup100: same MLP plus prespecified100 supervised continuation updates with full-source anchor

probability_normalizations: rawsoftmax T1 uncalibrated normalized reference; SVM margins are not probabilities
temperature fitted on source-only held-out OOF records
formula: p=w*p_svm+(1-w)*p_mlp; probabilities have fixed class order; not averaging raw scores

source_oof.dev_singleton_class: always in foldfit, excluded from its OOF calibration rows
source_oof.ownership: upstream probability track caches; fusion fits no source model or temperature

acceptance: interior weight must improve macroF1 over both matching-probability single endpoints and satisfy accuracy/balanced-accuracy guards in selection and gate
ranking: macroF1 tolerance.002; highest accuracy; closest weight to.5; provider/probability/id lexical
fallback: f015_fusion, prespecified mlp_sup100 source-OOF temperature alone (weight0), never chosen from final scores

probability_metrics.nll: negative mean log p_true with1e-15 clip
probability_metrics.brier: mean of sum over7classes squared errors; no division by7
probability_metrics.ece: 10 equally spaced maxconfidence bins including confidence1 in finalbin

complementarity: truth-based oracle accuracy upper bound, never an operational predictor
stage_barrier: development choice locked before final; final requires outputs/image-guided-20261031/all_development_locks.json covering own and upstream probability lock hashes
reporting: All source preprocessing/models and OOF temperatures are frozen input caches.
No target-support calibration and no query statistics fitted.
All seeds, endpoints, failed fusion candidates and formal fallback retained.
Repeated historical query specimens are not independent new batches.
Raw-softmax normalization is not a calibrated posterior.
Singleton source class lacks held-out OOF labels during development; final source rareclass n3 supports ordinary3fold.
